# ArksAI

> ArksAI is an **AI workforce** for UAE businesses. Instead of learning a tool, you **hire a worker** — a finance clerk, a front desk, a specialist — and manage it the way you manage staff: describe what you need in plain words (a message, a photo, a voice note, a quick approval), and it does the work, **checks its own output**, and hands back a finished, verified result — a live web app, a dashboard, a designed report or deck, on-brand ad/social creatives, real spreadsheets and documents, a customer reply, or the exact UAE-compliant filing the FTA and MOHRE expect. You can reach the worker on WhatsApp, Telegram, email, or in the studio. Website: https://arksai.studio (currently in alpha, invitation-only).

## What ArksAI is

ArksAI is "hire it, manage it, trust the output": an AI employee that does the work and verifies it **before** it hands it to you. It is built for **non-technical business owners and teams**, not developers. The promise is zero user iteration — the quality comes from the system (an opinionated design engine plus an internal verify-and-revise loop), not from the user's prompting skill. You approve the result, not the process.

The single biggest reason it exists: **let UAE businesses adopt AI without hiring or training AI-skilled staff, or even learning a tool.** A marketer, an accountant, an HR manager, or a founder manages an AI worker in plain language and gets expert-grade, verified output in their own language, the same day.

## Who it is for (per team)

- **Marketing** — conversion-focused landing pages (built live), on-brand ad & social creatives (real AI imagery with crisp, legible text and your logo), campaign briefs, content calendars, blog posts, competitor and audience research, performance reports.
- **Sales** — pitch decks, pricing & proposals, case studies, battlecards, ROI models, account plans, outreach sequences, pipeline trackers.
- **Finance / Strategy** — board decks, investor updates, KPI dashboards, formula-driven financial models (DCF, ratios, variance, forecasts), cash-flow models, scenario analysis, budgets.
- **HR / People & Ops** — job descriptions, offer letters, policies and handbooks, onboarding portals and checklists, surveys, people dashboards, runbooks.
- **Engineering** — internal tools, prototypes, admin panels, docs sites, metrics dashboards, API designs and tests, technical docs, dependency audits, code review.
- **BI & Analytics** — dashboards, data explorers, cohort and forecast analyses, scorecards, automated digests and alerts.
- **Tax & Compliance (UAE)** — VAT 201 working papers + FAF, Corporate Tax (CT 300) computations, monthly WPS salary files (SIF), PINT AE e-invoicing XML, Excise returns, readiness reviews.
- **Legal (UAE)** — contracts, NDAs, employment agreements, powers of attorney, corporate documents, notices, legal opinions, contract review, compliance audits — drafted to sign, bilingual (eloquent English + Modern Standard Arabic) where the destination requires it.

## What it can produce

- **Live web apps & dashboards** — built, booted in a real browser, and verified (it checks the app actually renders, routes work, and there are no errors) before you see it.
- **Designed reports, board decks & PDFs** — magazine-grade layout, real charts, embedded fonts, page-perfect.
- **On-brand ad & social creatives** — a finished PNG/JPEG: AI background imagery with reserved space, then pixel-crisp headline/sub/bullets/CTA and your logo composited on top (never the AI model's garbled lettering).
- **Editable spreadsheets (.xlsx) & documents (.docx) & decks (.pptx)** — formula-driven sheets, typographic documents, real editable slides.
- **UAE-compliant filing documents** — the exact validated artifacts each obligation requires; you review and submit through EmaraTax, your accredited e-invoicing provider, or your WPS agent bank.

## Why the quality is reliable

- An opinionated, typography-first design system with a bundled UI kit and a 120+ icon library, used across every output.
- A gating internal design + functional review: every visual deliverable is rendered and checked for legibility (WCAG contrast — in the resting AND hover states), mobile responsiveness, and senior-design-director quality, then automatically revised — so the user never has to iterate.
- Per-team expert standards baked in (FP&A rigor, inclusive HR, RevOps, brand growth, senior engineering, UAE tax & legal practice).

## Key facts

- Built specifically for the **United Arab Emirates** market and its compliance regime (FTA VAT/Corporate Tax/Excise, MOHRE WPS, PINT AE e-invoicing).
- **No AI or technical skills required** — you describe the task in plain language (English or Arabic) and review a finished result.
- Produces real, usable deliverables — not just chat answers.
- Currently **alpha, invitation-only**; request access at https://arksai.studio with a work email.

## Research & insights

ArksAI publishes sourced, cited essays on AI, energy and economics — written for business operators. Each article cites 14–15 real sources.

- **Energy is becoming the next currency** — why every AI "token" is ultimately priced in joules, the surge in data-centre electricity demand, compute as a strategic reserve asset, and how the Gulf's cheap, abundant energy positions the UAE to convert power into AI advantage. https://arksai.studio/research/energy-the-next-currency
- **The East and the AI frontier** — how the centre of gravity in frontier AI is shifting eastward (Chinese open-weight models, sovereign AI), where the US still leads, and the UAE's bet (Falcon/TII, MBZUAI, G42, Stargate UAE) to be an AI hub between East and West. https://arksai.studio/research/east-ai-frontier
- **How to read AI benchmarks (without being fooled)** — what the major benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, SWE-bench, LMArena, FrontierMath, HLE) actually measure, why leaderboard numbers mislead (contamination, saturation, Goodhart's law), and a practical framework for evaluating a model for your own use case. https://arksai.studio/research/reading-ai-benchmarks
